system.summary: A separate source-linked dossier for the certified DS950 central-count scanner/tabulator, including firmware and hardware revisions, documented motherboard and storage changes, output-transport firmware, central-count cart, and certified UPS alternatives.

certification.caveat: EAC certification applies only to the evaluated EVS 6.4.0.0 certified configuration. It does not establish the firmware, hardware, accessory selection, condition, or maintenance history of a particular field unit.

components.name: DS950 scanner and tabulator assembly
components.description: The certified scope describes a central scanner/tabulator that scans both sides of ballots or vote-summary cards in any of four orientations.
components.caveat: The certified revision and firmware are configuration records, not unit-level observations.

technicalSpecifications.label: Certified DS950 firmware
technicalSpecifications.caveat: This is the certified configuration version, not a field reading or a claim about later releases.

technicalSpecifications.label: Protected USB access
technicalSpecifications.value: Manufacturer states USB ports are behind clear lockable, sealable doors
technicalSpecifications.caveat: This establishes an access-control feature, not a connector count or the sealed condition of a field unit.

components.name: Ballot input feeder
components.description: The manufacturer photograph shows a purpose-built input feeder above the scanner body for central-count ballot batches.
components.caveat: The source supports the external feeder category and form, not exact dimensions or internal transport parts.

components.name: Dual-sided scanner path
components.description: The certified scope establishes simultaneous front-and-back scanning and four-orientation ballot handling.
components.caveat: The optical function is certified, but the illustrative path is not a teardown or engineering drawing.

components.name: Output transport and sorting trays
components.description: The output section receives processed ballots; baseline ECO 1151 records transporter-board firmware affecting when the output tray begins to lower.
components.caveat: The change record is not evidence of a jam, field update, unit condition, or exact output geometry.

components.name: Operator display
components.description: The manufacturer photograph shows an integrated operator-facing display on the DS950 enclosure.
components.caveat: The sources do not establish the exact panel model, resolution, connector, or internal placement.

components.name: Kontron motherboard with DRAM and TPM capabilities
components.description: The EVS 6.4.0.0 scope records an updated Kontron motherboard with DRAM and TPM capabilities.
components.caveat: The scope does not publish the board model, processor, DRAM capacity, TPM version, layout, or field history.

components.name: M.2 storage device
components.description: The EVS 6.4.0.0 scope records an M.2 hard drive added to the DS950 configuration.
components.caveat: The scope does not publish manufacturer, model, interface subtype, capacity, firmware, data, or field history.

components.name: Smart-card reader
components.description: The EVS 6.4.0.0 scope records a second-source smart-card reader for the DS950.
components.caveat: The public scope does not identify the reader model, placement, selected source, or field installation.

components.name: Central Count Cart
components.description: The certified system includes metal Central Count Cart model 7898 for the DS450, DS850, and DS950.
components.caveat: Certification identifies the cart option but does not prove its use or setup at a jurisdiction.

components.name: External uninterruptible power supply
components.description: The certified COTS hardware table names two CyberPower UPS alternatives that include the DS950.
components.caveat: The sources do not establish jurisdiction selection, workload runtime, battery health, or replacement history.

versionObservations.label: Certified DS950 firmware
versionObservations.caveat: This is the certified configuration version, not a field reading or unit update record.

versionObservations.label: Certified baseline DATAWIN transporter firmware
versionObservations.caveat: This is the firmware named in certified baseline ECO 1151, not a live readout or service record.

configurationChanges.description: The scope records an updated Kontron motherboard with DRAM/TPM capabilities, updated PC power supply, second-source smart-card reader, and M.2 hard drive.
configurationChanges.caveat: This groups certification modifications and is not a claim that one field service event installed them together.

configurationChanges.description: ECO 1151 updates DATAWIN transporter firmware so the output tray begins lowering sooner, providing more opportunity for incoming ballots to lay flat if a jam occurs.
configurationChanges.caveat: The de minimis ECO is certification history, not evidence of a jam, field update, or election impact.

findings.title: No anomalies reported in the EVS 6.4.0.0 certification campaign
findings.description: Pro V&V reported no anomalies during EVS 6.4.0.0 testing and recommended certification after the system met applicable VVSG 1.0 requirements.
findings.caveat: A bounded test result is not evidence that every fielded DS950 is defect-free or a claim about misconduct or outcomes.

power.description: The certified COTS hardware table names two CyberPower UPS alternatives that apply to the DS950.
power.caveat: The sources do not state a DS950 workload runtime or establish option selection, battery age, capacity, or condition.

scene.referenceConfiguration: DS950 manufacturer product form on the certified Central Count Cart category
scene.referenceNote: External proportions follow the manufacturer photograph. Internal forms, placement, scale, ports, cabling, paper path, and explosion offsets remain illustrative because no public teardown establishes them.

referenceImages.alt: Official product photograph of an ES&S DS950 high-speed scanner and tabulator on its wheeled support cart
referenceImages.caption: Manufacturer catalog photograph of the DS950 central-count scanner and tabulator.
referenceImages.derivativeNote: Local PNG conversion of the archived manufacturer JPEG at its original dimensions; no crop or content alteration.
referenceImages.caveat: External appearance only; the photograph does not establish dimensions, internal placement, firmware, accessories, or field configuration.

caveats: The DS950 is a separate central-count machine and must not inherit DS200 component claims.
The 3D scene is a navigation aid, not a teardown, wiring diagram, engineering drawing, installation, or unit inventory.
Unpublished motherboard, processor, memory, TPM, storage, and port-count details are not guessed.
Certified UPS alternatives do not establish which model or battery condition applies at a jurisdiction.
A certification change, ECO, or test result is not evidence of field occurrence, misconduct, or an election outcome effect.

reviewNotes: Approved for feature-gated staging as a separate central-tabulation dossier. Public production activation remains a separate decision.
